title: Short insert size WGS libraries preparation for assembly of the Lateolabrax maculatus genome
author: Chang Li
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.sszeef6

steps.title: Shear DNA fragments
steps.instruction: Shear the extracted DNA into fragments between 50 bp and ~800 bp using a Covaris E220 ultrasonicator.

steps.title: Select DNA fragment size
steps.instruction: Select fragments between 150 bp and 250 bp or 200 to 500 bp using AMPure XP beads (Agencourt, Beverly, the U.S.).

steps.title: Repair and adenylate DNA ends
steps.instruction: Repair DNA to obtain blunt ends and 3’-adenylate to create sticky ends using T4 DNA polymerase (ENZYMATICS, Beverly, the U.S.).

steps.title: Ligate adapters and amplify
steps.instruction: Ligate T-tailed adapters to both ends of the DNA fragments and amplify using the following PCR temperature profile:

substeps.instruction: 8 cycles of: 20 sec at 98 ℃, 15 sec at 60 ℃, and 30 sec at 72 ℃

steps.title: Purify PCR product
steps.instruction: Purify the PCR production using AMPure XP beads (Agencourt, Beverly, the U.S.).
